title: Installed skills carry their workflow sources or reference canonical IDs only
description: Skill folders reference workflow .md files that are not installed with them; audited agents fell back to scanning the entire home directory and found stale copies in unrelated checkouts. Either bundle referenced workflow files into skill installs or rewrite SKILL.md templates to reference canonical workflow IDs resolved via bwrk workflows show.
acceptanceCriteria: A fresh skill install can resolve every workflow reference without leaving the workspace
SKILL.md templates list refs in a form bwrk workflows show accepts verbatim
Doctor skill-root validation covers workflow source presence
closedReason: Canonical workflow refs and installed skill-root validation completed
